claim_scores.rationale: The repro uses a metric with a required third `trace` arg and shows `Evaluate(...)` yielding a failed item/zero score, matching that plain evaluation calls the metric without trace.
It asserts the one-example evaluation completes with score `0.0`, per-item score `0.0`, and an empty `Prediction` (`toDict() == {}`), which matches failure handling plus default `failure_score=0.0`.
It then runs `BootstrapFewShot.compile(...)` with the same metric and shows success, demonstrating the bootstrap path that passes `trace` to the metric rather than using plain `Evaluate`.
The metric records trace lengths and the program asserts `metric_trace_lengths == [1]` after bootstrap, correctly reflecting a single predictor step in the trace.
It asserts one bootstrapped demo, `demo.augmented is True`, correct demo fields, and `compiled._compiled is True`, matching bootstrap demo conversion/training behavior.
